I1.quote: The various gas (H2, CH4, and CO2) storage capacities of nanoporous CC-PNP and activated CC-PNP were evaluated by using an automated Sievert-type apparatus (PCTPro-E&E) with a so-called microdoser (MD) from Setaram.

I2.quote: Here, a flexible nanoporous activated carbon cloth was developed. Polypyrrole nanoparticles were polymerized in dispersed form on commercial viscose rayon cloth fiber surfaces. Then, the material was carbonized and activated by physical and chemical activation methods applied individually.
